prompts.title: Rate card
prompts.summary: Builds your rate card from your hours per deliverable and the hourly rate you want.
prompts.prompt: Help me build a rate card. I edit [types]. Time per deliverable: [e.g. short clip 45 min, 10-min YouTube 5 hours]. Target per hour: [$]. Rounds of revisions included: [ ]. Build three packages and per-piece prices, with a rush fee and what's not included. Then one paragraph I can paste into an email.
prompts.use: Send it as a PDF or put it on your site's services section.

prompts.title: Revision policy and the fourth-round reply
prompts.summary: A clear revision policy, and a friendly reply when a client asks for more rounds than you included.
prompts.prompt: Write a revision policy for [my business]: [n] rounds included, what counts as a round, how notes should come in (one list per round), and the price per extra round [$]. Then write a short, friendly reply for when a client sends round four.
prompts.use: Put the policy in every scope of work.

prompts.title: Edit brief from client notes
prompts.summary: Turns a client's loose notes into an edit brief you can cut from.
prompts.prompt: Turn these client notes into an edit brief: [paste notes]. Give: the goal of the video in one line, the audience, length, the hook in the first two seconds, the structure, music and caption style, brand rules, and the questions I should ask before I start.
prompts.use: Send the questions back the same day; start cutting once they answer.
